annotations.title: Hardware for a local AI assistant for Directum RX

description: How many CPU servers and how much memory a local LLM assistant for Directum RX needs (the model works with RX through MCP tools), from drxinfra measurements: llama.cpp on CPU, load tests with 1, 2 and 4 concurrent users and an answer quality check. Same model and numbers as drxinfra.ru/ai-sizing.html. Returns servers, memory, typical and p95 answer time, answers per hour, the quality score, and a comparison of all measured models on the chosen server.

hw.description: Measured server: icelake16 = Intel Xeon Ice Lake, 16 vCPU, 32 ГБ; m1pro = Apple M1 Pro, 8 ядер CPU

kv.description: KV cache type of the model server

model.description: Model: qwen3-4b = Qwen3 4B; qwen3-8b = Qwen3 8B; gigachat31 = GigaChat 3.1 10B-A1.8B; qwen3-30b-a3b = Qwen3 30B-A3B Instruct 2507

qph.description: Questions per hour from each of them

share.description: Percent of them asking in the peak hour, usually 10-30

toolset.description: RX tools given to the model: all = Все 27; pilot = 16 для пилота
